tasks.title: Schedule output: cron line or systemd timer, no daemon
tasks.dispositionReason: keryx trigger schedule <name> prints a cron line and a systemd service+timer pair, no daemon. Correct by construction: bakes in the resolved interpreter+script by absolute path (never bare keryx) plus an explicit PATH, and mkdir -p's the log dir before redirecting. AC6 proven by trigger-schedule.e2e.test.ts: spawns the printed cron command via sh -c with PATH=/usr/bin:/bin only and no TTY, asserts the rebuild actually ran.
